approvals.title: Top up Higgsfield credits
approvals.what: The Higgsfield balance is 1.84 credits, which is not enough to generate new photoreal imagery. A top-up lets the team make fresh images for the site. Until then the site uses renders we already own.
approvals.cost: You choose the amount. It is paid on your Higgsfield account.
approvals.risk: Low. Nothing on the site changes until new images are made and reviewed.

approvals.title: Turn on contact form email
approvals.what: Every brief is already saved here in HQ. Turning on email also sends each brief to your inbox the moment it arrives. You add two settings in Cloudflare: RESEND_API_KEY (a key from resend.com) and CONTACT_TO (the address briefs go to).
approvals.cost: Resend has a free plan for low volumes. Check their pricing page before you sign up.
approvals.risk: Low. If email fails, briefs are still saved in HQ.

approvals.title: Make the nsko-solutions GitHub repo private
approvals.what: Only people you invite will be able to see the website's code. The live website itself stays public.
approvals.risk: Low. After the switch, check that Cloudflare still has access to the repo so updates keep publishing.
